Use observed Kp as primary source, forecast as fallback

- Fetch observed Kp from NOAA planetary K-index JSON
- Use observed if current \(within active 3-hour window\)
- Fall back to forecast if observed data is stale
- Display source indicator in UI \(obs/fcst\)
- Reduced cache duration to 30 min for fresher data

Observed Kp is the actual measurement; forecast is a prediction.

EOF
\)")
